title: agoseris grandiflora var. laciniata
intro: Agoseris grandiflora var. laciniata, commonly known as the cutleaf agoseris or laciniated agoseris, is a plant species belonging to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). This perennial plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of A. grandiflora var. laciniata include its ability to reduce inflammation, prevent bacterial growth, and act as a natural antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
